description: Detach a parent keyword and every descendant from photo_ids, or all tagged photos with catalog_wide=true. Matches paths ignoring case; unknown parent fails unchanged. Preserves unrelated and same-named keywords elsewhere. Keyword nodes stay in the catalog and list_keywords. Use a dedicated parent such as 'AI Keywords' with set_keywords to undo a tagging batch. Returns updated (photos changed) and removed (keyword assignments removed); unknown IDs are not_found. Rules: give photo_ids or catalog_wide true, not both.

catalog_wide.description: Explicitly detach the subtree from every photo in the catalog; cannot accompany photo_ids

parent.description: Parent-first keyword path, for example 'AI Keywords' or 'Tags|AI Keywords'

photo_ids.description: Photos to detach the subtree from; omit when catalog_wide is true

name: remove_keyword_subtree
title: Remove keyword subtree
